facts.fact: Premium Times reports the Nigeria Data Protection Act, signed in June 2023, was the basis of the Commission's fine on Meta in February 2025.
Premium Times reports the Commission fined Meta $32.8 million under the Act on 18 February 2025, for unauthorised data transfers abroad, unsolicited advertising and an unfiled audit.
Premium Times reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission issued orders and defended them in the Federal High Court.
